title: C0mical Modpack
description: A Simple Modpack for me and all of my friends
body:
C0micly Simple Modpack
This modpack is a simple Minecraft 1.20.1 mostly consisting of exploration, adventure, and QOL mods. I created it because other, much larger, modpacks were all either too intensive or didn't fulfill the niche we wanted for many friends.

 

The main focus of this modpack will be adding in exploration content such as Additional Structures, Better End and Nether, Hopo's and YUNG's Better Structures, and the Origins mods
